I will not put chemical fertilizer on this small sorghum plot because a whole bag is too much for this piece and I do not have cash to buy one anyway. I will carry two baskets of manure from my homestead and spread it there because this land is mine and I want it to yield something. I will plant the seed I kept from last harvest, not the new type from the shop, since sorghum does not need that. My children and I will weed it and harvest it ourselves; the plot is too small to pay someone, and we do not spray medicine on sorghum or fetch water for it.
